-- Coloque este Script dentro de uma Part (plataforma) no Roblox Studio

local plataforma = script.Parent
local players = game.Players

-- Configurações
local valorMin = 1000000   -- 1M
local valorMax = 9999000000 -- 9999M
local velocidade = 10      -- Velocidade de subida

-- Faz a plataforma subir para cima infinitamente
while true do
	plataforma.CFrame = plataforma.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, velocidade * 0.1, 0)
	wait(0.1)
end

-- Quando alguém tocar na plataforma
plataforma.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local player = players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
	if player then
		-- Gera um valor de Brainrot aleatório
		local brainrot = math.random(valorMin, valorMax)

		-- Exibe no output (aqui você pode adaptar para seu sistema de pontos)
		print(player.Name .. " roubou " .. brainrot .. " Brainrot!")

		-- Torna a plataforma invisível
		plataforma.Transparency = 1
		plataforma.CanCollide = false

		-- Depois de 5 segundos reaparece
		wait(5)
		plataforma.Transparency = 0
		plataforma.CanCollide = true
	end
end)

local function CIORJCJ_script() -- Frame.LocalScript 
	local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', Frame)

	function dragify(Main)
		dragToggle = nil
		dragSpeed = 0.95 -- You can edit this.
		dragInput = nil
		dragStart = nil
		dragPos = nil
	
		function updateInput(input)
			Delta = input.Position - dragStart
			Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + Delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + Delta.Y)
			game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(Main, TweenInfo.new(.25), {Position = Position}):Play()
		end
	
		Main.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
				dragToggle = true
				dragStart = input.Position
				startPos = Main.Position
				input.Changed:Connect(function()
					if (input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End) then
						dragToggle = false
					end
				end)
			end
		end)
	
		Main.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			if (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
				dragInput = input
			end
		end)
	
		game:GetService("UserInputService").InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			if (input == dragInput and dragToggle) then
				updateInput(input)
			end
		end)
	end
	
	dragify(script.Parent)
	
	
end
coroutine.wrap(CIORJCJ_script)()
local function JJLB_script() -- disco.Script 
	local script = Instance.new('Script', disco)

	script.Parent.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
		local ColorCorrection = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect", Lighting)
	
		function zigzag(X) 
			return math.acos(math.cos(X*math.pi))/math.pi
		end
	
		Counter = 0
	
		Lighting.TimeOfDay = "12:00"
	
		while wait(0.1) do 
			ColorCorrection.TintColor = Color3.fromHSV(zigzag(Counter),1,1)
			Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromHSV(zigzag(Counter),1,1)
			Counter += 0.01
		end
	end)
	
end

scripts.title: Head Remover
scripts.features:
Just a simple headless script that destroys your head with destroy()

Might not work in some R6 and R15 games.
scripts.script:
-- LocalScript

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer

local function removeHead(character)
    local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if head then
        head:Destroy()
    end
end

local function onCharacterAdded(character)
 
    character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    
    removeHead(character)
    
    character:WaitForChild("Humanoid").Died:Connect(function()
        wait(0.1)
        removeHead(character)
    end)
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded)

if player.Character then
    onCharacterAdded(player.Character)
end

Here is me answering some of YOUR questions..

"is this ai?" -- In the early days of me scripting I had to use ai since was new but now I don't even need it.

scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local function removeFace(character)
 
    local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if head then
        local face = head:FindFirstChild("face")
        if face then
            face:Destroy()
        end
    end
end

local function onCharacterAdded(character)
  
    removeFace(character)

    character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
        if child.Name == "face" then
            child:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded)

if player.Character then
    removeFace(player.Character)
end
